_readme: Booth rental / recruiting page. The rental package list and the pitch are verbatim from the archived Wix 'Join our Team' page. Rental RATES were never published there — set `rateNote` or add real numbers before promising anything.
headlineLine1: Build your book in a room
intro: Flirt Lash Lounge & Day Spa offers the ultimate booth rental experience. Our luxury beauty stations are fully equipped for services such as eyelash extensions, lash lifts, skincare, waxing, permanent makeup, brow laminations, and more.
pitch: Our main focus is on helping you achieve success with your growing business, so we've made sure our rental rates are fair and affordable to help you do just that.
heroImageAlt: A Flirt artist wearing the branded salon apron.
imageAlt: The Flirt Lash Lounge artist collective together.

includes.title: Your own space
items: Fully equipped luxury beauty station, or a customizable private suite
Air conditioning, WiFi, and utilities included

includes.title: Your own business
items: Month-to-month rental with weekly or monthly payment options
Vagaro scheduling system with online booking
Discount on lash training and products

includes.title: Real support
items: Mentorship from a 15-year lash artist and educator
A referral network across a full-service menu
Continuing education through Aviara Beauty Academy
